name: BACH_0298
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (72%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs Benign · Read in turn
Invasive probability is under 1%; Normal and Benign stay inseparable at 90% coverage [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 72%, Normal 14%, InSitu 14% | Benign leads; invasive under 1% |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign | Two classes not separable |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.95 / 94th percentile | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Benign (4 Normal, 1 InSitu) | Neighbors disagree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign stroma/fat** (regions 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; lowers concept-model invasive term [F3] · Validated
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Mildly above typical; small contribution · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (regions 4, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Largest concept term, above typical [F2] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined in ducts** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Score low here; small invasive-leaning term [F4] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules failed spot check (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- True class is Normal or InSitu: 0/5 neighbors are Benign, and InSitu gets 14%.
- Sparse sampling hides tumor: only 3 regions segmented, insufficient tumor nuclei flagged.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 8**: confirm no atypical cells confined within ducts.
2. **Regions 4, 7, 11**: check lobule architecture; the normal-lobule score failed its spot check.
3. **Regions 7, 9**: HoVer-Net labelled 10 and 8 nuclei neoplastic; confirm they are benign.
